name: Who handles the plumbing and electrical work during a countertop replacement?

mainEntity.name: Who handles the plumbing and electrical work during a countertop replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Countertop installation requires disconnected supply valves, detached P-traps, unhooked garbage disposals, and disconnected cooktops. Many specialized stone installers do not provide plumbing or electrical services, leaving homeowners with a non-functional kitchen until separate trades are scheduled. It is essential to confirm whether your contractor manages mechanical reconnections. Working with an owner-operated remodeling company ensures coordinated trade support so plumbing and electrical systems are safely disconnected beforehand and reconnected promptly after adhesives cure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Countertop installers rarely handle utility work. You must arrange for plumbing and electrical disconnections and reconnections, or hire a contractor who coordinates these trades for you.
